Upper Text: [On Play][When Digivolving] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, gain 3 memory, and reveal 1 card in your hand. If it’s yellow, place it on top of your security stack face down. If it's not, return it to the hand.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] By trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon, and 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.
